content.comment_body: Hello Forum, I want to transfer some positional data (latitude, longitude, altitude, etc.) from a [product_name] system using a GNSS module to a [product_name] with [version_no] through an S7-style connection. I've already tested the communication between the controller and the GNSS module with basic logic, and it seems to work. My main question: Do I just need to create variables in the S7-style connection table that match the address locations of the position data? If so, how can I view these variables in [product_name] programming software? Should I use the network inputs/outputs to visualize them? I can't constantly test the variables in real time because the GNSS antenna requires unobstructed access to the sky.

analysis.insight_summary: The user seeks to transmit GNSS position data (latitude, longitude, altitude) from a [product_name] communication module to a [product_name] via an S7-style connection. There is confusion about how to configure the connection table and how to visualize the variables within the [product_name] programming tool. The main challenges are unclear instructions on mapping address locations and monitoring live data through the programming environment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants a clear and simple way to map GNSS variables using the S7-style connection table and be able to view or access these variables easily within the [product_name] programming interface.
